title: 2026-09-01 Session — Stage 2 Rulings
lede: Five decisions covering seven unresolved findings need a GM ruling. Evidence-backed transcript repairs and prose corrections are already applied.
footer: Applied without asking: 43 mechanical or editorial findings across five scene files. Three real-participant-name findings are registered for downstream scrubbing, and two checker findings were rejected from transcript evidence or the approved Stage 0 ruling. No card change will be made until decision JSON is returned.
